name: OpenSheetMusicDisplay
role: MusicXML scores to SVG notation in Node (with jsdom) or a browser, VexFlow-based
summary: OpenSheetMusicDisplay (OSMD) parses MusicXML and engraves it with VexFlow into SVG or canvas. In Node it needs jsdom plus a canvas package for text measurement; it is a library, not a CLI. Its SVG is mostly paths for notes, clefs and stems, with semantic classes (vf-stavenote, vf-notehead) so a scene can recolour or animate single notes; titles and lyrics are font-dependent <text>.
use_when: Engraved notation from MusicXML as an SVG layer; over music21 or mido, which do not draw
Per-note styling or animation: notes carry vf-stavenote and vf-notehead classes
Permissive BSD-3-Clause engraving for a bundled or hosted scene
avoid_when: Plain bars, chords or piano rolls with no score: draw with svg or canvas-2d
Notation that must match print-engraving quality and fonts exactly: a dedicated engraver
Audio or MIDI analysis with no drawing: music21 or mido
notes: 2026-11-27: The lead said 2.3.1; npm shows 3.0.0 (published 2026-11-26) and the example pins 3.0.0.
2026-11-27: Node route needs jsdom and HTMLCanvasElement.getContext patched to a @napi-rs/canvas context; the package is a CJS bundle, so ESM reads default.OpenSheetMusicDisplay.
2026-11-27: Lyric and title text stays <text font-family="Times New Roman">, so output depends on installed fonts and layout on measurement fonts; not path-only like mathjax.
2026-11-27: Proposed capability "music-notation" (and category "music notation engraving"); existing vocabulary used for now.

assessment.rationale: npm 3.0.0 published 2026-11-26; repository pushed 2026-11-26, not archived; BSD-3-Clause. Only catalogued route from MusicXML to engraved SVG; music21 and mido do not draw. Headless Node route works with jsdom and a canvas package.

evidence.result: Self-authored 4-bar MusicXML to SVG twice in separate Node 22.19.0 processes (jsdom 27.0.0, @napi-rs/canvas 1.2.1): identical SHA-256 cb783562…5b35c, 4 vf-measure, 11 vf-stavenote, 11 vf-notehead, lyrics as <text>; resvg 0.47.0 PNG 1800x696 inspected.
evidence.scope: One 4-bar melody, SVG backend under jsdom on macOS arm64; not Chromium, cursor, multi-system layout, .mxl, fonts, note recolouring or animation.
